AboutPage.title: About Hospital
AboutPage.subtitle: Dedicated to compassionate, world-class neurological diagnosis, minimally invasive neurosurgery, and patient-centered recovery.
AboutPage.hospitalSub: Comprehensive Neuro, Spine, Trauma & Stroke Management Centre
AboutPage.missionDesc: To deliver ethical, precise, and accessible brain and spine interventions. Through rigorous clinical protocols and modern microsurgical techniques, we ensure optimal restorative outcomes for each patient.
AboutPage.visionDesc: To establish a benchmark regional neurosciences institution recognised for patient trust, surgical safety, rapid acute stroke response, and transparent clinical care.
AboutPage.valuesSub: Principles that guide every surgical decision and consultation
AboutPage.val1Desc: Continuous adherence to international neurosurgical and patient safety benchmarks.
AboutPage.val2Desc: Empathetic listening and personalized guidance for patients and families throughout recovery.
AboutPage.val3Desc: Evidence-based advice, clear surgical indications, and transparent fee communication.
